summary.description: Executive summary of the adversarial verification pass and precision audit.

verifications.description: Adversarial evaluation results for all inspected candidate findings.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the evaluated vulnerability rule or hypothesis.

path.description: Relative file path of the candidate finding, or null when the scanner produced the candidate with no location at all. A pathless candidate is VALID INPUT - a normal output of this station's own pipeline - and the only honest verdict for it is 'unverifiable': scope the model's report rather than dying on data the station exists to report on. Widened beside line_number, which carries the same null for the same reason (agents-fy26); the findings[] path below stays a string, because a record that claims a verdict must have a location (agents-nhpb).

line_number.description: Line number where the candidate was flagged, or null when no line could be resolved. A candidate whose line is unknown (the scanner data carries line_number_unknown: true, or its line is the factory's '?' marker) is located by its path; cite the line you identified, or null when the claim has no single line (agents-fy26).

verdict.description: Verification verdict: 'verified' (genuine risk), 'disproved' (false positive / mitigated), or 'unverifiable' (the claim cannot be adjudicated because no location in the target could be identified - state the location you need instead of guessing). 'verified' and 'disproved' require a resolvable location; the report is rejected otherwise (agents-0tl).

confidence.description: Confidence level in the adversarial verdict.

reasoning.description: Adversarial justification citing specific source code evidence, sanitizers, auth gates, or lack thereof.

disproving_factors.description: Mitigating factors identified that disproved the finding, if applicable.

exploit_chain_viable.description: Whether the proposed exploit chain is practically realizable.

findings.description: Verified findings that survived adversarial testing.

path.description: Relative file path within the target repository.

line_number.description: Line number of the verified vulnerability, or null when the verified claim has no resolvable line (agents-fy26).

snippet.description: Exact code snippet corresponding to the vulnerability.

severity.description: Severity rating of the verified finding.

title.description: Human-readable title of the verified vulnerability.

description.description: Technical explanation of the confirmed exploitability and impact.

confidence.description: Confidence rating for this verified finding.

exploit_chain.description: Verified multi-hop exploit chain or execution narrative.
